name: Hrvatski sabor
notes: 151 seats. Club sizes are the 'Ukupno članova' figures on each of the 14 club pages of the 11th Sabor (sabor.hr, read 2026-11-04). The clubs overlap (the minority club repeats the SDSS members and three independents who also sit in other clubs), so each MP is counted once in the club that carries the party; the 'Other' row is the remainder to 151 (minority and non-club MPs, and any vacancy), not a counted figure. No supporter in the register sits in the Sabor today.
